column3: “Sit” is rendered “O captive,” following a different vowel reading, and “loosen” as “Loose yourself.”
“Beautiful” is rendered “lovely,” and “good” as “good news of happiness.”
“Eye in eye” is rendered “with their own eyes,” and “returns” as “restores.”
“He will prosper” renders a word that may also mean “act wisely.”
“On you” is expanded to “at you, My people”; NASB supplies “My people.”
“He will startle” is rendered “He will sprinkle.”
